title: Odile and the Colony
author: Cyrus Whitlock
blurb: Beatrix Vane, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
